sets.title: Invoice-totals method with blank lines inserted between statements
sets.description: The same invoice-totalling method in three service classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B has one blank line inserted between statements inside the clone; carrier C has two-line gaps at two interior points. The token stream is identical after whitespace normalization, so token/AST/metric tools should still match all three; a raw-line matcher will not.
sets.notes: Blank lines are inserted only at safe interior statement boundaries. Pristine (A) vs heavy (C) is the discriminating pair and remains a true Type-1 clone after whitespace normalization.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice vocabulary and foreach shape, but computes revenue/cost margins and a ratio — a different result
